description: DetectBench — labeled corpus for chimera_detect's two real signals. 'certainty': does the semantic strategy flag overconfident absolute-certainty phrasing? 'injection': does it raise an attack flag on prompt-injection text? flag=true means detect SHOULD fire. This is a task-appropriate corpus: chimera_detect screens phrasing/attack signals, not evidence entailment (that is chimera_verify's job, measured by the verify corpus).

certainty.description: Overconfident phrasing (flag=true) vs measured/hedged phrasing (flag=false). detect uses substring markers, so synonyms outside its list are expected misses — those are kept in deliberately to characterize recall honestly.

injection.description: Prompt-injection / instruction-override text (flag=true) vs benign requests (flag=false). Measured against detect's attack-pattern packs (OWASP MCP Top-10, AgentDojo, BIPIA, ...).
